candidate_labels: Inflammatory Myofibroblastic Tumor of the Urinary Bladder

Malignant Granular Cell Tumor: Immunohistochemical studies: tumor cells S-100 positive
Cystoscopy: approximately 4 × 3 × 3 cm solid tumor in the left postero-lateral wall, above the ureteric orifice
Tumor cells: pleomorphism, nuclear hyperchromasia, with 2–3 mitoses/10 HPF
Tumor arrangement: large clusters with diffuse sheets invading and insinuating in between the smooth muscle fibers
Ultrasound imaging: 2.6 × 1.8 cm polypoidal mass on the left posterior wall of the urinary bladder
Chief complaint: gross intermittent blood in urine
